'''''Spermacoce''''' or '''false buttonweed'''<ref>{{PLANTS|id=SPERM|taxon=Spermacoce|accessdate=25 November 2015}}</ref> is a [[genus]] of [[flowering plant]]s in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Rubiaceae]]. It comprises about 275 species found throughout the tropics and subtropics.<ref name="caroldigiorgio"/> Its highest diversity is found in the [[Americas]], followed by Africa, Australia and Asia. It can be used for the treatment of eczema by rubbing the leaves on the affected part. 

==Description==
The species are herbs or small shrubs with small- to medium-sized, four-lobed flowers arranged in capitate inflorescences. Some have a brightly coloured [[Calyx (botany)|calyx]] and are eye-catching, particularly the Australian species. The corolla is variable in colour, often white, but also all shades of blue, pink and maroon. The fruit is usually a two-seeded capsule, sometimes a [[schizocarp]] or nut.<ref>Davidse, G., M. Sousa Sánchez, S. Knapp & F. Chiang Cabrera. 2012. Rubiaceae a Verbenaceae. 4(2): i–xvi, 1–533. In G. Davidse, M. Sousa Sánchez, S. Knapp & F. Chiang Cabrera (eds.) Flora Mesoamericana. Missouri Botanical Garden Press, St. Louis.</ref>

==Selected species==
{{Main|List of Spermacoce species}}
''Spermacoce'' is a highly diverse genus with over 290 species in many tropical and subtropical places around the globe.<ref name="caroldigiorgio">[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/qsearch.do Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref> North American species include:<ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/north-america.php?state=AA&famiglia=Rubiaceae&genere=Spermacoce Alftervista Flora of North America ]</ref><ref>[http://bonap.net/NAPA/TaxonMaps/Genus/County/Spermacoce Biota of North America Program]</ref>

*''[[Spermacoce alata]]'' <small>Aubl.</small> - [[West Indies]], most of [[Latin America]]; naturalized in Africa, India, China, [[Southeast Asia]], Australia, [[Melanesia]]
*''[[Spermacoce brachysepala]]'' <small>(Urb.) Alain in H.A.Liogier & L.F.Martorell</small> - West Indian false buttonweed - [[Puerto Rico]], Haiti, Dominican Republic
*''[[Spermacoce capitata]]'' <small>Ruiz & Pav.</small> -  baldhead false buttonweed - [[Central America|Central]] and South America from Belize to Argentina
*''[[Spermacoce confusa]]'' <small>Rendle</small> -  river false buttonweed - [[Florida]], West Indies, Latin America from Mexico to Argentina
*''[[Spermacoce densiflora]]'' <small>(DC.) Alain</small> -  bouquet false buttonweed - Florida, West Indies, Latin America from Mexico to Argentina
*''[[Spermacoce eryngioides]]'' <small>(Cham. & Schltdl.) Kuntze</small> -  whorled-leaf false buttonweed - West Indies including Puerto Rico; southeastern South America from Bolivia and Brazil to Argentina
*''[[Spermacoce exilis]]'' <small>(L.O. Williams) C. Adams</small> - Pacific false buttonweed - Latin America from Mexico to Argentina, plus West Indies; naturalized in Africa, China, India, southeast Asia and some tropical oceanic islands
*''[[Spermacoce glabra]]'' <small>Michx.</small> - smooth false buttonweed - southern and eastern United States (mostly in the [[Lower Mississippi Valley]]); also South America
*''[[Spermacoce keyensis]]'' <small>Urb</small>. - Florida false buttonweed - southern Florida, [[Bahamas]], southern tip of [[Texas]] ([[Cameron County, Texas|Cameron County]])
*''[[Spermacoce neoterminalis]]'' <small>Govaerts</small> - Everglades false buttonweed-  southern Florida
*''[[Spermacoce ocymoides]]'' <small>Burm.f.</small>
*''[[Spermacoce ovalifolia]]'' <small>(M. Martens & Galeotti) Hemsl.</small> -  broadleaf false buttonweed - West Indies including Puerto Rico, Latin America from Mexico to Paraguay
*''[[Spermacoce prostrata]]'' <small>Aubl.</small> -  prostrate false buttonweed - Florida, [[Mississippi]], [[Alabama]], West Indies including Puerto Rico; most of Latin America; naturalized in China, Vietnam, Sri Lanka and [[Java]]
*''[[Spermacoce remota]]'' - Lam. -  woodland false buttonweed - Florida, [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], Texas, Alabama, West Indies, much of Latin America; naturalized in Southeast Asia, China, India, [[New Guinea]], [[Mauritius]] and many oceanic islands (including [[Hawaii]])
*''[[Spermacoce tenuior]]'' <small>L.</small> -  slender false buttonweed - Texas, [[Louisiana]], Georgia, West Indies; Latin America from Mexico to Bolivia; naturalized in Tanzania, [[Java]], [[Sulawesi]] and [[Galápagos]]
*''[[Spermacoce tetraquetra]]'' <small>A. Rich. -</small>  pineland false buttonweed - Florida, West Indies, Mexico, Central America
*''[[Spermacoce verticillata]]'' <small>L.</small> -  shrubby false buttonweed - Florida, West Indies, most of Latin America; naturalized in Africa, Australia, assorted oceanic islands
